We brought it back.
settings.text: Project Skin exists because the industry sold ritual instead of root cause — trends, influencers, and miracle claims over evidence. We sell literacy first, formulations second.

settings.card_1_heading: Skin is an organ — not a canvas
settings.card_1_text: What you apply does not stay on the surface. It penetrates dermal layers and enters your bloodstream. That is not a warning — it is the mechanism we build around. Skin is health, not decoration.
settings.card_2_heading: Engineered for Indian skin — not adapted
settings.card_2_text: Climate volatility, pollution, high UV, hard water, and lifestyle stress: global formulas were never built for this. We design from the ground up for Indian skin, climate, and daily life.
settings.image_2_alt: Calm, healthy skin — long-term biology over overnight claims

settings.heading: The problem
settings.text: Indian skincare became a cosmetic tradition — rituals, trends, influencers, and miracle claims instead of actual skin health.

settings.heading: The realisation
settings.text: Skin is the body’s largest organ. What you apply is absorbed, not just displayed — making this a health issue, not only an appearance one.

settings.heading: The gap
settings.text: Indian skin faces climate swing, pollution, UV, and lifestyle stressors that Europe / US / Korea formulas were never engineered to solve.

settings.heading: The beginning
settings.text: Five founders built Project Skin to bridge science, technology, and skincare — specifically for Indian skin, climate, and life.

settings.heading: The approach
settings.text: Diagnose first, formulate second. Every product starts from root causes — not surface symptoms or trending ingredients.

settings.heading: The vision
settings.text: Become India’s most trusted science-led skin-health ecosystem — decisions driven by data and transparency, not hype.

settings.heading: From frustration to a clearer standard
settings.text: A short arc: why Indian skincare needed a health ecosystem — and how Project Skin began.

settings.heading: Literacy first
settings.text: A customer who understands their skin never buys the wrong product again. Education is the product — formulation comes second.

settings.heading: Root cause over ritual
settings.text: Most products quiet symptoms temporarily. We ask why the concern exists — biology, climate, and lifestyle included.

settings.heading: Diagnose, then formulate
settings.text: Indian skincare stayed cosmetic for too long. We make it part of a health ecosystem: understand the problem before prescribing a product.

settings.heading: Every ingredient earns its place
settings.text: Clinical evidence. Efficacious concentration. Right delivery technology. Nothing for the label alone.

settings.heading: What we refuse to compromise
settings.text: Science over trends. Health over hype. A “Project” — because fixing skin is a systematic, evidence-led process, not a product promise.

settings.quote: We sell literacy first, formulations second — because trust should arrive before the sale.

settings.heading: Science first
settings.text: Clinical evidence guides every formulation decision — at every step of the process.

settings.heading: Efficacious doses
settings.text: We don’t add niacinamide for the list. We deliver concentrations where peer-reviewed studies show visible results.

settings.heading: Barrier-first thinking
settings.text: Treatment should not cost you your barrier. Repair and active care are designed to work together.

settings.heading: Engineered for Indian skin
settings.text: Climate range, pollution load, and biology — accounted for from the start, not bolted onto a global formula.

settings.heading: Actives + technology
settings.text: Right actives, right delivery, real results — ingredients and technology chosen to work together, not independently.

settings.heading: Root-cause formulas
settings.text: Products address the underlying cause of a concern — not the ingredient of the month.

settings.heading: Right actives. Right technology. Real results.
settings.text: Every line is built to solve a diagnosed concern — with honesty about what is in it, why it is there, and what it will do.

settings.heading: Science first
settings.text: We follow the science that creates trends — not the trends themselves. Mechanism over marketing theatre.

settings.heading: Education before purchase
settings.text: We tell you exactly what is in a product, why it is there, and what it will do — literacy before the cart.

settings.heading: Long-term skin health
settings.text: Healthy skin is a biological goal. Success is measured over time — not overnight transformation claims.

settings.heading: Built to earn curiosity — then trust
settings.text: Purpose, precision, performance, integrity, and inclusivity. Skin has no gender, shade, or type that deserves less. Keep learning with us.
